bodyOriginMeaning: Projected schematic whole-body locator. It records anatomical location; it is not a rigid transform between source views.
orientationPolicy: Head side sections, posterior gland views, magnified samples, alternative pelvis and pregnancy views retain their own scale and orientation. Animate a locator/frame or camera transition; do not imply a literal rigid 3D rotation.
